name: Field Operator
summary: Installs, calibrates, and maintains recording hardware.
description: Operates the local recording setup and prepares raw audio for analysis. Cares that deterministic pre-analysis checks catch malformed capture inputs before downstream classifiers or review tooling consume them.

distinguished_from.how: Handles recording operations and capture quality, while the location owner defines the place-specific source policy and accepted species scope.
Works at the operational edge with audio capture inputs; does not own orchestration or execution of the capability graph.
